اعتذرتا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَذَرَتَا (iʕtaḏaratā) /iʕ.ta.ða.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
# اُعْتُذِرَتَا (uʕtuḏiratā) /uʕ.tu.ði.ra.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِعْتَذَرَ (iʕtaḏara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
